name: Play with my perception
source:
A simple story about a guy named Artem, who cannot accept himself because of his past and does not even want to try. He needs to survive his entire college program and keep from losing his mind around his new classmates. Maybe he will find love or friends, or perhaps both... Or maybe nothing at all?

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/pwmpONLINEFREE/26]Telegram[/url]]
translation:
一个简单的故事，讲述了一个名叫阿尔乔姆的人，他因为自己的过去而无法接受自己，甚至不想尝试。他需要完成整个大学课程，并防止在新同学面前失去理智。也许他会找到爱情或朋友，或者两者兼而有之……或者也许什么也没有？

[译自[url=https://t.me/pwmpONLINEFREE/26]Telegram[/url]]
